The classical five subtypes of Hodgkin lymphoma in the older classification are:

  1. Nodular sclerosis

  2. Mixed cellularity

  3. Lymphocyte predominance

  4. Lymphocyte depletion

  5. Unclassified

Therefore, monocyte depletion is not a subtype of Hodgkin lymphoma. ✅

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Nodular sclerosis → most common

  • Mixed cellularity → common, especially in advanced disease

  • Lymphocyte-rich/predominance → favorable prognosis

  • Lymphocyte-depleted → poor prognosis

  • Monocyte depletion → not a subtype

Exam Pearl:
Hodgkin lymphoma has “lymphocyte depletion,” not “monocyte depletion.”

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ৯৪) Physiological cause of ketonuria excludes.....?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
Ketonuria occurs physiologically when the body shifts from glucose metabolism toward fat metabolism, increasing ketone-body production.

  • Prolonged starvation → ketone production ↑ 

  • Low-carbohydrate diet → ketogenesis ↑ 

  • High-fat diet → can promote ketone production, particularly when carbohydrate intake is low 

  • Orthostatic → associated with orthostatic proteinuria, not ketonuria 

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Physiological ketonuria: starvation, fasting, low-carbohydrate/ketogenic diet

  • Pathological ketonuria: DKA, alcoholic ketoacidosis, severe vomiting

Exam Pearl:
Orthostatic → proteinuria, not ketonuria.

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ৯৫) Greenish sputum indicates.......?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
Greenish sputum is classically associated with Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection. The green color is due to pigments produced by the organism, particularly pyocyanin and pyoverdine.

  • Pseudomonas → green/blue-green sputum ✅

  • Anthracosis → black pigmentation due to carbon deposition.

  • Actinomycosis → may produce sulfur granules.

  • Bronchiectasis → can cause copious purulent sputum, but green sputum is not specific for it.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Pseudomonas → green/blue-green sputum

  • Klebsiella → thick “currant jelly” sputum

  • Pulmonary TB → blood-streaked sputum/hemoptysis

  • Lung abscess → foul-smelling purulent sputum

Exam Pearl:
Green sputum → think Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ৯৬) Which is an immunological method of pregnancy test?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
The latex agglutination test is an immunological method of pregnancy testing. It detects hCG (human chorionic gonadotropin) in urine using an antigen–antibody reaction.

The other tests are biological/animal-based pregnancy tests:

  • Toad test → biological test using toad

  • Friedman test → biological test using rabbit

  • Hogben test → biological test using frog

  • Latex agglutination test → immunological test ✅

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Immunological pregnancy test → Latex agglutination

  • Hormone detected → hCG

  • Modern pregnancy tests → immunochromatographic urine hCG tests

Exam Pearl:
Latex agglutination = immunological pregnancy test.

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ৯৭) Which specimen is used for OBT?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
OBT (Occult Blood Test) is performed on stool to detect hidden (occult) blood that is not visibly apparent.

It is commonly used to screen for gastrointestinal bleeding, including as part of colorectal cancer screening.

  • Stool → OBT specimen 

  • Blood → used for hematological/biochemical tests

  • Urine → used for urine occult blood testing, but not the standard meaning of OBT

  • Sputum → used for respiratory investigations

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • OBT → Stool

  • Detects occult GI bleeding

  • Positive result → may require further evaluation, such as endoscopy/colonoscopy depending on context.

Exam Pearl:
OBT = Occult Blood Test → stool sample.

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ৯৮) Which one is good cholesterol?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
HDL (High-Density Lipoprotein) is commonly called the “good cholesterol.” It helps transport excess cholesterol from peripheral tissues back to the liver for metabolism and excretion, a process known as reverse cholesterol transport.

  • HDL → “Good” cholesterol 

  • LDL → “Bad” cholesterol; promotes atherosclerosis

  • VLDL → transports mainly triglycerides

  • TG (triglycerides) → a type of lipid, not a cholesterol-containing lipoprotein

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • HDL ↑ → generally protective

  • LDL ↑ → atherosclerosis risk ↑

  • VLDL → triglyceride-rich lipoprotein

  • TG → triglyceride

Exam Pearl:
HDL = Good cholesterol; LDL = Bad cholesterol.

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ৯৯) Which enzyme is more sensitive & cardiospecific?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
Creatine kinase (CK), particularly the CK-MB isoenzyme, is more cardiospecific than LDH, AST, or ALT and was historically used for detecting myocardial infarction (MI).

  • CK-MB → relatively cardiospecific and rises early after MI 

  • LDH → less specific; LDH-1 was historically associated with cardiac injury.

  • AST → found in many tissues, so poorly specific.

  • ALT → primarily associated with liver injury.

Modern practice: Cardiac troponins (cTnI/cTnT) are more sensitive and specific than CK-MB and are the preferred biomarkers for myocardial injury.

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Most specific modern cardiac marker → Troponin I/T

  • CK-MB → useful for detecting reinfarction

  • AST → nonspecific

  • ALT → liver

Exam Pearl:
For this MCQ: CK (especially CK-MB).

Subject Final-04 Pathology.question: ১০০) Which is the most common site for Crohn's disease?
Subject Final-04 Pathology.exp:
The distal (terminal) ileum is the most common site of Crohn’s disease. Crohn’s can affect any part of the gastrointestinal tract, from mouth to anus, but the terminal ileum and ileocecal region are classically involved.

  • Distal ileum → most common site 

  • Stomach → less common

  • Duodenum → uncommon

  • Rectum → less commonly involved; Crohn’s often spares the rectum

High-Yield Rapid Recall:

  • Crohn’s → terminal ileum

  • Skip lesions

  • Transmural inflammation

  • Non-caseating granulomas may be present

  • Cobblestone mucosa

Exam Pearl:
Crohn’s disease → terminal ileum is the classic/commonest site.
